flows.title: View your account and content insights
steps: Select Dashboard from the left-hand menu.
On a professional account, select Insights below For professionals; on a personal account, select Your dashboard below Your insights.
From the Insights drop-down menu, select Account or Content.
Use the drop-down menu to set the period you want: the last 7, 14, 30 or 90 days, or a range of your own.
